description: This file defines the 'ReportingMethod' entity class within the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models the reporting method for employees, with properties for id and name, and maintains a one-to-many relationship with 'ReportTo' entities.

classes.name: ReportingMethod
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's reporting method with properties for id, name, and related reportTo records.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the reporting method's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method's unique identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reporting method.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reporting method.
